technical-summary: Factored sealed memfd verification and strict NativeConfigSnapshot reconstruction into a shared NativeConfigSnapshot::from_sealed_fd function; the native engine inspector now reuses it. Added a private v3-only --bc-native-config-fd bc-serve writer option that loads the snapshot before draft and measured plan-key generation and populates ManifestInputs. The v3 writer fixture round-trips its snapshot through a sealed fd. bc_serving_v3_writer_test, exact-recipe ABI44 consumer CTest, and ordinary v2 bc_serving_test pass (1/1 each); standalone bc-serve compiled against generated v3 and rejected the private fd option outside write-manifest mode. No session caller, production gate, GPU use or performance claim.
user-summary-candidate: Unified sealed native snapshot reading and added a private v3 writer handoff path. Focused v2/v3 checks pass; session and production native admission remain fail-closed.
